statements.query: FETCH FORWARD 500 FROM wamn_stream

DECLARE wamn_stream NO SCROLL CURSOR FOR SELECT
    model.created_at,
    model.created_by,
    model.id,
    model.purchase_order_number,
    model.row_version,
    model.status,
    model.supplier_id,
    model.updated_at,
    model.updated_by
FROM purchase_order AS model
WHERE
    ($1::jsonb IS NULL OR model.supplier_id IN (
        SELECT filter.value::uuid
        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb) AS filter(value)
    ))
    AND
    ($2::jsonb IS NULL OR model.status IN (
        SELECT filter.value::text
        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb) AS filter(value)
    ))
    AND
    ($3::jsonb IS NULL OR EXISTS (
        SELECT $7
        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($3::jsonb) AS filter(value)
        WHERE strpos(model.purchase_order_number, filter.value) > $8
    ))
    AND
    ($4::timestamptz IS NULL OR model.created_at > $4::timestamptz
        OR (model.created_at = $4::timestamptz AND model.id > $5::uuid))
ORDER BY model.created_at ASC, model.id ASC
LIMIT $6::int8
SELECT 1 FROM app_system.users WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2::text::uuid
SELECT status = $1 FROM app_system.environment

SELECT COALESCE(current.version, $3) FROM unnest($1::text[], $2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS named (schema_name, relation_name, position) LEFT JOIN wamn_cache.model_versions AS current USING (schema_name, relation_name) ORDER BY named.position

SELECT user_roles.role_name, permissions.permission FROM app_system.users AS users JOIN app_system.user_roles AS user_roles ON user_roles.tenant_id = users.tenant_id AND user_roles.user_id = users.id LEFT JOIN app_system.permissions AS permissions ON permissions.tenant_id = user_roles.tenant_id AND permissions.role_name = user_roles.role_name WHERE users.tenant_id = $1 AND users.id = $2::text::uuid AND users.status = 'active'
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT $2 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles AS authority WHERE authority.rolname = $1 AND pg_catalog.pg_has_role(CURRENT_USER, authority.oid, $3))

SELECT set_config('app.tenant', $1, true), set_config('statement_timeout', $2, true), set_config('search_path', COALESCE($3, current_setting('search_path')), true), set_config('app.runner', COALESCE($4, current_setting('app.runner', true)), true), set_config('app.role', $5, true), set_config('app.user_id', $6, true), set_config('app.operation', $7, true)
SELECT id::text, display_name FROM app_system.users WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id::text = ANY($2) AND display_name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(display_name) <> $3 ORDER BY id
SELECT pg_logical_emit_message($1, $2, $3)
SELECT wamn_cache.bump_version(relation ->> $16, relation ->> $17)

WITH target AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id, row_version
    FROM purchase_order
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
    FOR UPDATE
),
updated AS (
    UPDATE purchase_order AS model
    SET
        supplier_id = CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN $4::uuid ELSE model.supplier_id END,
        row_version = CASE
            WHEN ($3::boolean AND $4::uuid::text IS DISTINCT FROM model.supplier_id::text)
            THEN model.row_version + $5
            ELSE model.row_version
        END
    FROM target
    WHERE model.id = target.id
      AND target.row_version = $2::int4
    RETURNING
    model.created_at,
    model.created_by,
    model.id,
    model.purchase_order_number,
    model.row_version,
    model.status,
    model.supplier_id,
    model.updated_at,
    model.updated_by
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT $6 FROM target) THEN $7
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT $8 FROM updated) THEN $9
        ELSE $10
    END AS outcome,
    (SELECT target.row_version FROM target) AS observed_row_version,
    updated.created_at,
    updated.created_by,
    updated.id,
    updated.purchase_order_number,
    updated.row_version,
    updated.status,
    updated.supplier_id,
    updated.updated_at,
    updated.updated_by
FROM (SELECT $11) AS singleton
LEFT JOIN updated ON $12
INSERT INTO app_system.write_log (operation, idempotency_key, request) VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $3::bytea) ON CONFLICT (operation, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING idempotency_key
SELECT 1 FROM app_system.users WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2::text::uuid
UPDATE app_system.write_log SET result = $3::text WHERE operation = $1::text AND idempotency_key = $2::text AND result IS NULL RETURNING idempotency_key
SELECT status = $1 FROM app_system.environment
SELECT id::text, display_name FROM app_system.users WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id::text = ANY($2) AND display_name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(display_name) <> $3 ORDER BY id

SELECT user_roles.role_name, permissions.permission FROM app_system.users AS users JOIN app_system.user_roles AS user_roles ON user_roles.tenant_id = users.tenant_id AND user_roles.user_id = users.id LEFT JOIN app_system.permissions AS permissions ON permissions.tenant_id = user_roles.tenant_id AND permissions.role_name = user_roles.role_name WHERE users.tenant_id = $1 AND users.id = $2::text::uuid AND users.status = 'active'
SELECT entry.value FROM jsonb_each(changed) AS entry ORDER BY entry.key COLLATE "C"

SELECT set_config($7, $1, $8), set_config($9, COALESCE($2, current_setting($10)), $11), set_config($12, COALESCE($3, current_setting($13, $14)), $15), set_config($16, $4, $17), set_config($18, $5, $19), set_config($20, $6, $21)
